General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 64,924.21 acres, which realized $462,682. The quantity of surrendered land
in the hands of the department was approximately 229,010 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of Indian lands
sold, amounted to $911,641.19, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
